title: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. (NYSE: ASX) — Institutional Underwriting Dossier
archetype: Cyclical Scale Leader in Structural AI Packaging Upgrade
primer: ASE Technology Holding (NYSE: ASX) is the world's largest OSAT with ~27–28% global share. Its AI LEAP packaging revenue is scaling from ~$1.6B in FY25 toward >$4.0B in FY26, lifting ATM gross margin to 30.6% in Q3 2026. However, US$11.5B in FY26 CapEx and a Stage 3 pullback (-15.13% 1M to $35.55) demand discipline. Hold the 82 Schwab shares (3.29% weight) with a $29.25 hard stop, while new capital waits for $33.25–$34.75 support.
holding_rationale: Schwab holds 82 shares at $2,500.59 cost ($30.50/sh), worth $2,915.10 today (+16.58% gain, 3.29% of $88,684.68 net worth). Price sits +4.13% above the rising 200-day SMA ($34.14) and near Pivot S1 ($35.21) after a Q3 beat and +47% Oct revenue print. Selling into a pullback offers poor risk/reward. We hold and enforce a hard $29.25 daily-close stop below the $29.58 20-day swing low.
